以 UNDP HDR 2025 的 GII 时间序列连接 Esri World Countries Generalized，比较 2010–2019 年性别不平等指数变化。差值定义为 **GII 2019 − GII 2010**；负值表示该指标下降，正值表示上升。

GII 范围为 0–1；差值是指数值之差，不是人数、百分比或百分点。任一年缺失或连接未匹配时保留 NA，不归为“无变化”。

## 结果摘要

244 条地图边界记录中，154 条有完整两年差值：145 条 GII 下降、9 条上升；90 条缺失或未匹配。

## 环境

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE, dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 120)
```

### 依赖安装（缺包时）

```{r install-if-needed, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("sf", "tidyverse", "tmap", "countrycode", "jsonlite", "ragg", "readxl", "rmarkdown", "knitr", "here"))
```

### 包与项目路径

```{r packages-and-root}
root <- here::here()
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
```

## 数据版本与下载路径

UNDP HDR 2025 完整时间序列包含 `gii_2010` 和 `gii_2019`；历史数值可能随版本修订。世界边界使用教程指定 Esri 图层的官方 FeatureServer GeoJSON 接口，未更换数据集。边界为概化版本，不视作两年各自的精确历史边界。

```{r input-paths}
raw_dir <- file.path(root, "data", "raw", "week04")
dir.create(raw_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
undp_url <- "https://hdr.undp.org/sites/default/files/2025_HDR/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv"
metadata_url <- "https://hdr.undp.org/sites/default/files/2025_HDR/HDR25_Composite_indices_metadata.xlsx"
world_layer_url <- paste0(
  "https://services.arcgis.com/P3ePLMYs2RVChkJx/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "World_Countries_(Generalized)/FeatureServer/0")
world_url <- paste0(world_layer_url, "/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson")
world_count_url <- paste0(world_layer_url, "/query?where=1%3D1&returnCountOnly=true&f=json")
undp_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv")
metadata_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "HDR25_Composite_indices_metadata.xlsx")
world_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "world-countries-generalized.geojson")
world_count_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "world-countries-count.json")
file.exists(c(undp_file, metadata_file, world_file, world_count_file))
```

### 下载

UNDP 链接如返回 403，可从[官方下载页](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/documentation-and-downloads)保存相同的完整时间序列和元数据。

```{r download-inputs, eval=FALSE}
options(timeout = 1200)
download.file(undp_url, undp_file, mode = "wb")
download.file(metadata_url, metadata_file, mode = "wb")
download.file(world_count_url, world_count_file, mode = "wb")
download.file(world_url, world_file, mode = "wb")
```

### 本地文件

```{r verify-inputs}
stopifnot(all(file.exists(c(undp_file, metadata_file, world_file, world_count_file))))
expected_count <- jsonlite::read_json(world_count_file, simplifyVector = TRUE)$count
```

## 元数据与 GII 字段

`gii` 是指数，`gii_rank` 是排名。建议引文位于元数据的 `recommended_citation` 表；CSV 版本使用 Windows-1252。

```{r read-metadata}
readxl::excel_sheets(metadata_file)
codebook <- readxl::read_excel(metadata_file, sheet = "codebook")
stopifnot(all(c("Full name", "Short name", "Time series") %in% names(codebook)))
codebook %>% filter(stringr::str_detect(as.character(`Short name`), "^gii(_rank)?$"))
```

### 完整时间序列

所有字段先按文字读取，随后显式转换两年指数；缺失标记不包含数值 0。

```{r read-undp}
hdr_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  undp_file, locale = readr::locale(encoding = "Windows-1252"), # 保留源文件编码
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "n/a", ".."), trim_ws = TRUE)
names(hdr_raw) <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", names(hdr_raw)))
stopifnot(all(c("iso3", "country", "gii_2010", "gii_2019") %in% names(hdr_raw)))
readr::problems(hdr_raw)
dim(hdr_raw)
hdr_raw %>% dplyr::select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>% head(10)
```

## 国家／地区记录

按 ISO3 代码排除世界和区域等汇总行，并保留排除清单。

```{r country-rows}
hdr_codes <- hdr_raw %>% mutate(iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(iso3)))
valid_iso3 <- unique(na.omit(countrycode::codelist$iso3c))
hdr_codes <- hdr_codes %>% mutate(is_country = !is.na(iso3) & iso3 %in% valid_iso3)
excluded_aggregates <- hdr_codes %>% filter(!is_country) %>% dplyr::select(iso3, country)
excluded_aggregates
gii_text <- hdr_codes %>% filter(is_country) %>% dplyr::select(iso3, undp_name = country, gii_2010, gii_2019)
stopifnot(!anyNA(gii_text$iso3), !anyDuplicated(gii_text$iso3))
```

### 数值与范围

两年指数逐列转换，非缺失字符串转换失败时停止；有效值限定 0–1，代码保持文字。

```{r numeric-gii}
gii <- gii_text %>% mutate(
  gii_2010 = readr::parse_double(gii_2010, na = c("", "NA", "..")),
  gii_2019 = readr::parse_double(gii_2019, na = c("", "NA", "..")))
conversion_failures <- gii_text %>% filter(
  (!is.na(gii_2010) & is.na(gii$gii_2010)) | (!is.na(gii_2019) & is.na(gii$gii_2019)))
conversion_failures
stopifnot(nrow(conversion_failures) == 0L)
stopifnot(all(is.na(gii$gii_2010) | dplyr::between(gii$gii_2010, 0, 1)))
stopifnot(all(is.na(gii$gii_2019) | dplyr::between(gii$gii_2019, 0, 1)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(gii$iso3), !anyDuplicated(gii$iso3))
summary(gii[c("gii_2010", "gii_2019")])
```

## 世界边界与 ISO 转换

Esri `ISO` 为 ISO2，转换到 UNDP 的 ISO3。`COUNTRYAFF` 和 `AFF_ISO` 是所属国字段，不用于把所属国 GII 复制到领土。未识别代码单独保留。

```{r read-world}
world_raw <- sf::st_read(world_file, quiet = TRUE)
names(world_raw)
stopifnot(all(c("FID", "COUNTRY", "ISO", "COUNTRYAFF", "AFF_ISO") %in% names(world_raw)))
stopifnot(nrow(world_raw) == expected_count)
stopifnot(!is.na(sf::st_crs(world_raw)))
world_raw <- sf::st_transform(world_raw, 4326)
world_raw <- sf::st_make_valid(world_raw)
world_raw <- world_raw %>% mutate(
  iso2 = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(as.character(ISO))),
  iso3 = countrycode::countrycode(iso2, origin = "iso2c", destination = "iso3c", warn = FALSE))
unmapped_boundary_codes <- world_raw %>% filter(is.na(iso3)) %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(FID, COUNTRY, ISO, COUNTRYAFF, AFF_ISO)
unmapped_boundary_codes
```

### 多部件几何与唯一键

同 ISO3 的地理部分通过 sf union 合为一行，保留来源名称与部分数。未知代码分别保留独立连接键。

```{r prepare-world-keys}
boundary_parts <- world_raw %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!is.na(iso3)) %>%
  count(iso3, name = "parts") %>% filter(parts > 1L)
boundary_parts
world_known <- world_raw %>% filter(!is.na(iso3)) %>% group_by(iso3) %>%
  summarise(world_name = paste(sort(unique(COUNTRY)), collapse = " / "),
            source_parts = n(), do_union = TRUE, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(join_key = iso3)
world_unknown <- world_raw %>% filter(is.na(iso3)) %>% transmute(
  iso3 = NA_character_, world_name = COUNTRY, source_parts = 1L,
  join_key = paste0("unmatched_boundary_", FID))
world <- bind_rows(world_known, world_unknown)
stopifnot(!anyNA(world$join_key), !anyDuplicated(world$join_key))
stopifnot(all(sf::st_is_valid(world)))
```

## 一对一左连接

按 ISO3 一对一左连接，保留全部边界并列出双向未匹配记录。

```{r check-and-join}
world_table <- sf::st_drop_geometry(world)
no_gii_for_boundary <- dplyr::anti_join(world_table, gii, by = c("join_key" = "iso3"))
no_boundary_for_gii <- dplyr::anti_join(gii, world_table, by = c("iso3" = "join_key"))
no_gii_for_boundary %>% dplyr::select(world_name, iso3, join_key)
no_boundary_for_gii %>% dplyr::select(iso3, undp_name)
world_gii <- dplyr::left_join(
  world, gii, by = c("join_key" = "iso3"), relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(world_gii) == nrow(world))
stopifnot(!anyNA(world_gii$join_key), !anyDuplicated(world_gii$join_key))
world_gii %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(world_name, undp_name, iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>% head(10)
```

## 2010–2019 变化

计算 `gii_change = gii_2019 - gii_2010`；完整配对和缺失分别记录，NA 不归入 No change。

```{r calculate-change}
world_gii <- world_gii %>% mutate(
  gii_change = gii_2019 - gii_2010,
  change_group = case_when(
    is.na(gii_change) ~ "Missing one/both years",
    gii_change < 0 ~ "GII decreased",
    gii_change > 0 ~ "GII increased",
    TRUE ~ "No change"))
coverage <- world_gii %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% summarise(
  map_rows = n(), complete_pairs = sum(!is.na(gii_change)), missing_pairs = sum(is.na(gii_change)))
coverage
world_gii %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% count(change_group)
stopifnot(coverage$complete_pairs > 0L)
stopifnot(all(is.na(world_gii$gii_change) | dplyr::between(world_gii$gii_change, -1, 1)))
```

## 零中心差值地图

负差值蓝色、正差值红色，色标以零对称；缺失为灰色。颜色表示指数变化，不表示人口数量。

```{r map-change}
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")
limit <- max(abs(world_gii$gii_change), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(limit) || limit == 0) limit <- 0.01
gii_change_map <- tmap::tm_shape(world_gii) +
  tmap::tm_polygons(
    fill = "gii_change", col = "grey40", lwd = 0.25,
    fill.scale = tmap::tm_scale_continuous(
      limits = c(-limit, limit), midpoint = 0,
      values = c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"),
      value.na = "grey80", label.na = "Missing 2010 or 2019 / unmatched"),
    fill.legend = tmap::tm_legend(title = "GII 2019 − GII 2010")) +
  tmap::tm_title("Change in Gender Inequality Index, 2010–2019") +
  tmap::tm_credits("UNDP HDR 2025; World Countries Generalized: Esri and sources")
gii_change_map
```

### 表格与分布核对

按两个方向排序对照图色；直方图观测单位为完整配对的地图国家／地区，不是人口，也非人口加权全球结果。

```{r inspect-results}
matched_complete <- world_gii %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!is.na(gii_change))
matched_complete %>% dplyr::select(iso3, world_name, gii_2010, gii_2019, gii_change) %>%
  arrange(gii_change) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
matched_complete %>% dplyr::select(iso3, world_name, gii_2010, gii_2019, gii_change) %>%
  arrange(desc(gii_change)) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
summary(matched_complete$gii_change)
hist(matched_complete$gii_change, breaks = "FD",
     main = "Country-level GII change, 2010–2019", xlab = "GII 2019 minus GII 2010")
abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey30")
```

## 可选导出

CSV 保存属性、GPKG 保存空间结果、PNG 保存地图；文件名附运行时间。

```{r export-results, eval=FALSE}
run_tag <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S", tz = "Europe/London")
output_dir <- file.path(root, "week04", "outputs")
figure_dir <- file.path(root, "week04", "figures")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
csv_target <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("gii-change-2010-2019-", run_tag, ".csv"))
gpkg_target <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("gii-change-2010-2019-", run_tag, ".gpkg"))
png_target <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0("gii-change-2010-2019-", run_tag, ".png"))
stopifnot(!any(file.exists(c(csv_target, gpkg_target, png_target))))
readr::write_csv(sf::st_drop_geometry(world_gii), csv_target, na = "NA")
sf::st_write(world_gii, gpkg_target, layer = "gii_change", quiet = TRUE)
tmap::tmap_save(gii_change_map, png_target, device = ragg::agg_png,
                width = 12, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 200)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(c(csv_target, gpkg_target, png_target))))
c(csv_target, gpkg_target, png_target)
```
